description: Reference preset for the generic impetus-ext-lsp MCP server. Not a separate binary.
notes: Install rust-analyzer on PATH (rustup component add rust-analyzer).
Set IMPETUS_LSP_WORKSPACE to the Cargo workspace root, or pass workspace to lsp_start.
Then call lsp_start with command=rust-analyzer and workspace=<root>, or rely on env defaults.
Architecture remains generic — swap command for clangd, gopls, pyright, etc.
